rust_summary: tinting the sky dome and the clouds for a frame (`native_set_sky_tint`).
doc_summary: On a client, `native_set_sky_tint(color, strength)` draws the sky dome and the cloud layer `strength` (0 to 1) of the way from their colour to `color` (RGB, 0 to 1) in the next frame built. Call it every frame the tint should show: a frame it is not called on is drawn as vanilla draws it. Fog, terrain, water and the other stages are not tinted. Bundles need fragment @API:sky_tint@.
